task_description: Implement 17 new features in the artex-ko Go+PostgreSQL security testing platform: CVSS scoring, LLM observability, continuous monitoring, skill files (Linux LPE, whitebox analysis, GraphQL, WebSocket, cloud audit), vector memory, Sigma rule generation, CTF mode, CI/CD integration, dedup logic, HTML/PDF reports, resource library, TOTP, benchmarks, and retest UI enhancements.
